mapper.insert: INSERT INTO mrp_inventory_balance (inventory_snapshot_id, factory_code, inventory_org, warehouse_scope, material_code, inventory_quality, available_quantity, source_row_ref, included_flag, normalization_rule_version) VALUES (#{inventorySnapshotId}, #{factoryCode}, #{inventoryOrg}, #{warehouseScope}, #{materialCode}, #{inventoryQuality}, #{availableQuantity}, #{sourceRowRef}, #{includedFlag}, #{normalizationRuleVersion})

INSERT INTO mrp_inventory_balance (inventory_snapshot_id, factory_code, inventory_org, warehouse_scope, material_code, inventory_quality, available_quantity, source_row_ref, included_flag, normalization_rule_version) VALUES
(#{item.inventorySnapshotId}, #{item.factoryCode}, #{item.inventoryOrg}, #{item.warehouseScope}, #{item.materialCode}, #{item.inventoryQuality}, #{item.availableQuantity}, #{item.sourceRowRef}, #{item.includedFlag}, #{item.normalizationRuleVersion})
mapper.update: UPDATE mrp_inventory_balance SET available_quantity=#{availableQuantity}, included_flag=#{includedFlag}, normalization_rule_version=#{normalizationRuleVersion} WHERE id=#{id}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM mrp_inventory_balance WHERE inventory_snapshot_id=#{snapshotId} ORDER BY factory_code, material_code
SELECT * FROM mrp_inventory_balance WHERE inventory_snapshot_id=#{snapshotId} ORDER BY factory_code, material_code
SELECT * FROM mrp_inventory_balance WHERE inventory_snapshot_id=#{snapshotId} AND included_flag=1 ORDER BY factory_code, material_code
SELECT * FROM mrp_inventory_balance WHERE inventory_snapshot_id=#{snapshotId} AND material_code=#{materialCode} AND included_flag=1

SELECT inventory_snapshot_id as inventory_snapshot_id, factory_code, inventory_org, warehouse_scope, material_code, inventory_quality, SUM(available_quantity) as available_quantity, included_flag FROM mrp_inventory_balance WHERE inventory_snapshot_id=#{snapshotId} AND included_flag=1 GROUP BY factory_code, inventory_org, warehouse_scope, material_code, inventory_quality ORDER BY factory_code, material_code, inventory_quality
